description: Backend Goal API pass-through proxy. Make every football endpoint read Goal API directly on every request with no DB match storage; remove the secondary football providers and the football sync cron; remove the FootballMatch Prisma model; fix the currently-broken backend build by deleting the dead src/common/app.module.ts. Cricket and the WebSocket live-push are preserved. The backend must compile (`npm run build` = 0 errors).
steps: DELETE backend/src/common/app.module.ts (dead duplicate with wrong import paths; src/main.ts already uses src/app.module.ts). This removes the 6 TS2307 errors that currently break `npm run build`.

Edit backend/prisma/schema.prisma: remove the entire `model FootballMatch { ... }` block (the football match storage). Keep CricketMatch, CricketScorecard, SyncLog (cricket still logs syncs), and ApiUsage (retained so QuotaService/QuotaModule still compile; removing them is out of scope).

Edit backend/src/providers/provider.types.ts: add `id: string;` and `lastSyncedAt: Date;` to the `NormalizedFootballMatch` interface so the proxy output matches the frontend FootballMatch contract. (The deleted secondary providers also used this interface, but they are being deleted in a later step, so no other provider needs to set these.)

Edit backend/src/providers/goal-api.provider.ts: in `normalize()`, add `id: f.id,` and `lastSyncedAt: new Date(),` to the returned object (so `id === goalApiId`). Add a new public method `async getFixtureNormalized(fixtureId: string) { const f = await this.getFixtureDetail(fixtureId); return f ? this.normalize(f) : null; }` used by match detail. Keep all existing methods and endpoints unchanged.

DELETE backend/src/providers/football-provider.manager.ts, backend/src/providers/football-data.provider.ts, backend/src/providers/api-football.provider.ts, backend/src/providers/thesportsdb.provider.ts (Goal API covers all football now).

Edit backend/src/providers/providers.module.ts: remove imports + providers + exports of ApiFootballProvider, FootballDataProvider, TheSportsDbProvider, FootballProviderManager. Keep GoalApiProvider and CricketProviderManager (providers + exports).

Rewrite backend/src/football/football.service.ts as a Goal API pass-through: constructor `constructor(private goalApi: GoalApiProvider) {}`; drop `implements OnApplicationBootstrap`, the PrismaService injection, the FootballProviderManager injection, the `match-identity` import, and ALL sync/merge/cleanup/upsert/hasActivity/logSync/getMatch(simple)/safeStatus/updateData/findDuplicate methods. Implement: `getLive()` = Promise.all([goalApi.getLive().catch(()=>[]), goalApi.getResultsToday().catch(()=>[])]) then dedupe by `id` (live first) and return; `getFixtures()` = goalApi.getByDate(today) filtered to status==='NS' && kickoff>=now, sorted asc, take 50; `getResults()` = goalApi.getResultsToday(); `getByDate(date)` = goalApi.getByDate(date); `getMatchDetail(id)` = :id is the goalApiId — Promise.all([goalApi.getFixtureNormalized(id).catch(()=>null), goalApi.getEvents(id).catch(()=>[]), goalApi.getStatistics(id).catch(()=>null), goalApi.getLineups(id).catch(()=>null), goalApi.getCommentary(id).catch(()=>[])]); if !match throw NotFoundException('Match not found'); return { match, events, statistics, lineups, commentary, goalApiAvailable: true }. Keep getStandings/getTeam/getTeamSquad/getTeamResults/getTeamFixtures/getTopLeagues unchanged. `getProviderStatuses()` returns [this.goalApi.status].
Edit backend/src/football/football.controller.ts: remove the four @Post sync handlers (sync/live, sync/today, sync/date/:date, sync/upcoming) and the now-unused `Post` import. Keep all @Get handlers.

Edit backend/src/football/football.module.ts: change `providers: [FootballService, PrismaService]` to `providers: [FootballService]` (FootballService no longer injects PrismaService). Keep `imports: [ProvidersModule]` and `exports: [FootballService]`.

Edit backend/src/sync/sync.service.ts: keep `runJob` and `syncCricket` unchanged. Change `syncFootballLive()` body to `const matches = await this.football.getLive(); this.liveGateway.pushFootballUpdate(matches);` (no DB writes, no results/cleanup sub-calls). DELETE the `syncFootballToday`, `syncGoalApiResults`, and `syncUpcoming` cron methods. Keep the `@Cron('*/2 * * * *')` on syncFootballLive and `@Cron('*/5 * * * *')` on syncCricket.

Run `cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npx prisma generate` (regenerates the Prisma client so `prisma.footballMatch` is gone). Optionally `npx prisma db push` to drop the table in Postgres (needs `docker compose up -d`). If the DB container is not running, `prisma generate` alone is enough for the build to pass.
Verify: `cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npm run build` reaches 0 errors.
acceptance_criteria: `cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npm run build` exits with 0 errors.
No file under backend/src imports or references the deleted providers (FootballProviderManager, ApiFootballProvider, FootballDataProvider, TheSportsDbProvider).
No file under backend/src references `prisma.footballMatch` (the model is removed from schema.prisma and the code).
FootballService has no PrismaService dependency and no sync methods; its read methods proxy Goal API.
SyncService has no football sync/today/upcoming/results cron; it only runs the cricket cron and the football live-push timer.
Cricket endpoints and cricket sync are untouched (CricketService/CricketProviderManager unchanged).
verification: cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npm run build  (expect: 0 errors, exit 0)
cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npx prisma generate  (expect: success; client regenerated without footballMatch)
cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit is equivalent to the build if nest build is unavailable — prefer `npm run build`
findings: Completed. Verification: `npm run build` = 0 errors (exit 0, run twice — before and after prisma generate, both clean); `npx prisma generate` succeeded (Prisma Client v5.22.0, no footballMatch delegate). Facts later steps need: (1) id === goalApiId on EVERY normalized football match — GoalApiProvider.normalize() sets both `id: f.id` and `goalApiId: f.id` to the same value, and getLive/getByDate/getResultsToday/getFixtureNormalized all flow through normalize(), so the frontend FootballMatch.id === goalApiId invariant holds on every endpoint (live/fixtures/results/by-date and the match-detail `match` object). (2) Cricket is fully untouched — CricketService, CricketProviderManager, CricketModule, cricket.controller, cricket.service unchanged; the cricket cron (*/5) and runJob are kept verbatim; CricketMatch/CricketScorecard/SyncLog/ApiUsage Prisma models retained. (3) FootballService is a pure Goal API pass-through with no Prisma: getLive dedupes [getLive, getResultsToday] by id (live first); getFixtures = today's getByDate filtered to status==='NS' && kickoff>=now, asc, take 50; getResults = getResultsToday; getByDate passthrough; getMatchDetail(id) treats id as the goalApiId and fans out getFixtureNormalized/getEvents/getStatistics/getLineups/getCommentary in parallel, throws NotFoundException if no match, returns goalApiAvailable:true. (4) SyncService gutted to only syncFootballLive (*/2, calls football.getLive() and pushes via WebSocket, no DB) + syncCricket (*/5); football sync/today/upcoming/results cron methods deleted; runJob kept for overlap protection. (5) football.controller.ts has no @Post routes left (Post import removed); all @Get handlers kept. (6) PrismaService removed from FootballModule (import + provider dropped). (7) backend/src/football/match-identity.ts is now an orphan (no longer imported anywhere) but intentionally KEPT — it compiles standalone and tsconfig has noUnusedLocals off; a later cleanup step may delete it. (8) ENVIRONMENT NOTE: a backend dev server (`npm run dev` -> ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/main.ts) was running and held the Prisma query-engine DLL, which blocked `npx prisma generate` with a Windows EPERM-on-rename error. To complete verification I stopped ONLY that backend dev tree (PIDs 34644/11024/32444). The user's Expo frontend dev server (`expo start --android`, PIDs 27004/10304) was left running and untouched. The backend is now STOPPED — the integration/release step must restart it (e.g. `npm run dev` in backend/). (9) No frontend (android/) or docs (docs/, PROGRESS.md) files were modified in FEAT-001 — those are separate features.
